fact_exactly_one_value.name: fact_exactly_one_value
fact_exactly_one_value.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "fact"."value_numeric" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN "fact"."value_text"    IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN "fact"."value_boolean" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN "fact"."value_date"    IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        = CASE WHEN "fact"."is_null" THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      )

fact_null_reason_requires_null.name: fact_null_reason_requires_null
fact_null_reason_requires_null.value:
("fact"."is_null" = true AND "fact"."null_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("fact"."is_null" = false AND "fact"."null_reason" IS NULL)

coverage_expectation_sucessor_ck.name: coverage_expectation_sucessor_ck
coverage_expectation_sucessor_ck.value: "coverage_expectation"."succeeded_by_attribute_code" IS NULL OR "coverage_expectation"."effective_until" IS NOT NULL

unidade_tem_identidade.name: unidade_tem_identidade
unidade_tem_identidade.value: "unidade"."cnpj" IS NOT NULL OR "unidade"."codigo_gerencial" IS NOT NULL
